params.body:
Small things seen while taking screenshots on a local demo instance. Each is fixed where it is rendered, with a test where one fits.

## Fixed
- **Website photos 404 on sealed environments.** `WebsiteController::image` asks `fileExists()`, which `DemoMediaDisk` did not override, so it reached the real folder only and missed files written under `demo/`. `fileExists`, `fileMissing`, `checksum`, `response` and `download` now resolve the path like the other read methods. Production does not use this wrapper.
- **The phone ⋯ sheet listed duplicate and delete twice.** The block added for widths below 1550px (`.ui-narrow-only`) and the phone block (`.d-md-none`) both rendered under 768px. View and edit stay at the top of the menu; duplicate and delete sit once at the bottom (the phone order), shown wherever the button column is hidden, in both the Livewire and the classic row.
- **Showroom slide without a photo for an own vehicle that is not on the stocklist.** The slide always took the platform copy. An own vehicle without one now shows its own primary photo, the fallback the downloaded slide (`ShowroomSlide`) already made; a colleague's vehicle never falls back to its original (R S1-6.39). The silhouette comes from `public/images` instead of a bucket lookup through the photo route. `primary_photo` is eager-loaded in both showroom modes (still two photo queries per batch). Rule R S2-7.8 updated.
- **Wording and format:** the "no portals" chip had its cross glued to the text (the `gap: 0` for stacked portal icons also hit this chip); "Alle 1 wagens geladen." is now singular via `trans_choice` (both list ends, four languages); the expected mileage on the bidding detail uses `Custom::formatNumber` like the mileage; `vehicle.average_price` and `find_average_price_end` said "maanden" in en/fr/de; the seller address on the vehicle detail goes through `Custom::address` (no space before the comma when there is no number addition).
- **Short pages ended in a lighter band under the footer:** the theme gives `body` #edf1f5 and `.page-wrapper` #eaeef4; the body now carries the page colour when there is a page wrapper. refresh.css stays at 6134 lines.

## Left alone
- Cleanliness "zeer slecht" on the detail: demo data only. `DemoScreensSeeder` sets `cleanliness_*` and `engine_status` to 1 (= very bad) for bidding vehicles; an empty score (0) already renders as not filled in.
- "Kilometerstand 31000", "€204,00" and the "UNIEKE KEY" column header live in the transport views (`settings/transport/*`, `mails/transport*`), which are being changed in a parallel pull request.

## Tests
`ShowroomTest`, `OwnStockRowMarkupTest`, `DemoMediaTest` (new cases, each fails on main), new `ScreenWordingTest`. Full suite locally: 2366 tests green. PHPStan clean. Pint on the new file.

Fixes bevinding 2026-09-29-kleine-dingen-op-de-schermen.
